# A bill applying the two splits of a supplier refund.
#
# The signs are wrong for a payment. A bill's posting puts −100.00 on the
# payable, so its payment puts +100.00 there. These two splits are −60.00 and
# −40.00, so applying them would add −100.00 to a lot that already holds the
# posting's −100.00: the lot would reach −200.00 and the bill would read as
# owing 200.00, with every figure still balancing.
#
# Refused by the sign, which is the one thing that is not the same on both
# sides of a link.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal, with the transaction untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-REFUND-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-08
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-08
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-08
    due: 2026-04-08
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-REFUND-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-08
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Due From Director USD"
    Transaction "4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb"
      PaymentSplit "6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb4c5d"
      PaymentSplit "7f8a9b0cddeeff00112233aabb4c5d6e"
